A.scope: Known audited completed prefix plus explicitly terminal partial facts. Until host final, this is not a full planned44 actual cost; unstarted/running outcomes are not zero results.

B.scope: Known audited completed prefix plus explicitly terminal partial facts. Until host final, this is not a full planned44 actual cost; unstarted/running outcomes are not zero results.

time_scope: Whole worker lifetime includes loading, inference, actions, final boundaries and closure, once per resident. Native/test/preparation/acceptance intervals are nested, never added to worker occupancy. Saved execution elapsed_seconds are wall time, not measured CPU core-seconds; sandbox CPU limits are only limits. Preparation function wall time includes any nested preparation driver. Each submitted slot runs one independent private and one public acceptance driver on its final locked tree, not two private acceptances.

submission_costs.scope: First fixed submission is not first correct solution. Costs include every member and the submitting call; worker time is not estimated at submission boundaries.
